g.text: A 2 × 2 experiment separates message and appeal.
Reconstructed experiment layout using the supplied stimulus assets. Argument quality and peripheral appeal form the 2 × 2 design.
Speciesism is a measured moderator, separate from the 2 × 2 assignment.
